citationText: 3. Directivity index (DI = 10 log Q): This is the level difference in intensity along a given axis, and at a given distance, from a sound radiator compared to the intensity that would be produced at the same distance by an omnidirectional point source radiating the same power. The directivity factor (Q) is the ratio of the two intensities.
